title: Computers for Cynics 2 - It All Went Wrong at Xerox PARC
summary: Ted Nelson, in his Computers for Cynics series, gives a critical history of Xerox PARC's vision of personal computing. He lists what he sees as the limitations and wrong turns in PARC's approach to the desktop and documents.
why: HN readers treat it as a contrarian counterpoint to the usual PARC mythology, though one commenter noted a few apparent mistakes in it.

quote.text: Nelson's history is a breath of fresh air.
